skills.name: engineering-director
skills.description: Leads the full product development cycle: priorities, task split, cross-specialty coordination, conflict prevention, merge and release-readiness decision.

skills.name: repository-intelligence
skills.description: Full repository analysis: architecture, component relationships, technical debt, dependencies and risks; produces audit documents.

skills.name: android-architecture
skills.description: Android/Kotlin architecture and layering, Android 7 (API 24) to Android 16 (API 36) compatibility, CI-verifiable build constraints.

skills.name: autonomous-feature-inventor
skills.description: Proactive discovery of genuinely valuable features: user-need analysis, modern technique study, solution comparison, value/risk/cost scoring.

skills.name: performance-engineering
skills.description: Measurement-based performance work: FPS, frame time, CPU, RAM, thermal; bottleneck discovery; no unproven claims.

skills.name: adaptive-engineering
skills.description: Adaptive optimization engine and repeatable A/B experiments: measure before applying, stop on risk.

skills.name: system-integration-engineering
skills.description: Shizuku/root/shell/sysfs integration: permission and session checks, command failure and timeout handling, no unsafe changes.

skills.name: thermal-safety-engineering
skills.description: Absolute priority of thermal protection; blocks any optimization that conflicts with device safety; clear experiment stop limits.

skills.name: reliability-and-recovery
skills.description: Journal and rollback engineering, crash/interruption handling, no restoring over external changes, corrupted-log detection.

skills.name: automated-testing
skills.description: Comprehensive automated tests: failure and edge cases, concurrency and cancellation, Android compatibility; CI enforcement.

skills.name: security-engineering
skills.description: Permission review, command-injection prevention, input validation, data and privacy protection.

skills.name: adversarial-review
skills.description: Independent adversarial code review: hunt bugs the developer missed, regressions and risks, block unsafe changes.

skills.name: release-engineering
skills.description: Version management (versionName/versionCode), APK build, artifact and signature verification, changelog and test reports, GitHub release.
